name: Four Seasons Resort Lanai
insider_take: This luxury resort sits on Hawaii's most secluded island, where you'll have pristine beaches practically to yourself and world-class amenities in an intimate setting.
whats_special: Four Seasons Resort Lanai is located on Hawaii's "Pineapple Isle," a private island that was once entirely owned by Dole and used for pineapple cultivation. The resort features the championship Manele Golf Course, designed by Jack Nicklaus, which offers dramatic clifftop holes overlooking the Pacific. Lanai is home to just 3,200 residents, making it one of the most exclusive and uncrowded Hawaiian destinations.
pro_tip: Book a dolphin watching excursion to Spinner Dolphin Point - the waters off Lanai's coast are home to one of Hawaii's largest populations of Hawaiian spinner dolphins.
dont_miss: Hulopoe Beach, consistently ranked among the world's best beaches, sits right at the resort's doorstep with its pristine white sand and crystal-clear waters perfect for snorkeling. Take a short hike to Sweetheart Rock (Puu Pehe), a dramatic 80-foot sea stack with ancient Hawaiian legends and breathtaking sunset views.
pros: Pristine beaches and championship golf course
cons: Remote island location requires additional travel planning
